# Historical LGPL runtime notice

This file is retained for source-history references only. The portable Windows build no longer packages the BtbN LGPL runtime and does not copy this file into release ZIPs.

The current portable runtime is the SHA-256-pinned 64-bit BtbN GPL build with `libx264`; see [FFmpeg-GPL-NOTICE.md](FFmpeg-GPL-NOTICE.md) for the applicable source and license notice.
